d: Tensions between the Samajwadi Party and Congress over seat-sharing are growing ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Akhilesh Yadav has indicated that discussions have taken place on 26 seats, while Congress is seeking a much larger share. The SP has also announced five candidates, including nominees for Behat and Saharanpur Dehat, two seats Congress leader Imran Masood has been seeking. The disagreement has triggered a war of words between leaders of both parties.
